text:
dan (Customer): Hi, hitting 403 when trying to add a team member to our project in the console. They used SSO invite. Steps I did:
1) Settings -> Org -> People -> Invite -> pasted email -> assign Project Editor -> click Invite
2) UI shows success, but the new user gets "403 Permission denied" when opening the project.

Error shown in app and API callback: 
```
{
  "error": "403 Permission denied",
  "message": "user lacks project.update permission",
  "request_id": "req_0a1b2c3d4e5f"
}
```

Screenshots: https://files.example.com/repodump/403-screenshot.png
This started after we changed our SSO group -> role mappings yesterday. Need help, customer blocked.

sarah (Support): Thanks @dan — sorry about the outage. Quick Qs: which org and project IDs? Are you using SCIM auto-provisioning or manual SSO invites? Did the user get an email acceptance link?

dan (Customer): Org: org_88f9, Project: prj_114. We use Okta SCIM + group mappings. The user accepted the invite but still blocked. SCIM sync shows last run 12:05 UTC.

oncall-bot: Audit log ingest completed for org_88f9 at 1765432200

sarah (Support): Can you paste the request_id from the 403 (you already did — thanks). I'll pull the audit events and escalate to eng if needed. Meanwhile: can you check the user in the org members list and confirm their role string? In console Settings -> People -> click the user -> it shows both org role and per-project role.

alex (Eng): Looping in eng. @sarah can you paste the raw audit snippet or the request_id? I want to see the authorization decision.

sarah (Support): Using request_id req_0a1b2c3d4e5f — pulling logs...

alex (Eng): From logs (redacted):
```
timestamp: 2026-02-14T12:26:40Z
request_id: req_0a1b2c3d4e5f
actor: dan@customer.com
action: project.open
decision: DENY
reason: missing_permission
missing: ["project.update"]
source: sso-group-sync
rule: group-map:okta->project_roles: 'devs' => Viewer
```
Looks like the Okta group mapped to Viewer at project scope. Viewer doesn't have project.update. If the UI invited them as Project Editor but SCIM later reconciled the group and overwrote to Viewer, that could cause a silent downgrade.

marta (Product): We had a customer report similar; current behavior: SCIM group mapping is authoritative if SCIM provisioning is on. Manual console additions can be overwritten at next sync. We should make that clearer in the invite flow. Filing a follow-up.

sarah (Support): Quick repro steps for you to confirm:
1) Go to Settings -> Auth -> SCIM -> Group mappings -> search for the Okta group (name: "redwood-devs").
2) Confirm mapped role (org or project) and scope.
3) If it's set to Viewer, change to Project Editor or add a project-specific mapping.

If you prefer CLI/API to force a sync:
```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/orgs/org_88f9/sso/sync
```
That will reapply mappings immediately. Also you can inspect the member object via API: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/orgs/org_88f9/members?email=dan%40customer.com
```
check the returned `roles` array.

dan (Customer): I checked the group mapping — Okta group "redwood-devs" accidentally mapped to Viewer after a mapping cleanup. Changing to Project Editor and running the sync fixed it for one user.

sarah (Support): Great, can you confirm the user can now access the project?

dan (Customer): Confirmed. They can access, no 403, and the audit log shows grant applied. Thanks! 
```
timestamp: 2026-02-14T12:31:10Z
entry: role_change: project: prj_114 user: dan@customer.com old: Viewer new: Project Editor source: sso-sync request_id: req_0a1b2c3d4e5f
```

alex (Eng): Root cause: mismatch between manual invite and authoritative SCIM mapping. Action items:
- Short term: support to guide customers to check SCIM group mappings and run immediate sync.
- Mid term: product to add UI hint/warning when inviting a user while SCIM is enabled.
- Long term: consider transient grace period where manual per-user assignments override SCIM until next sync or provide a merge policy.

marta (Product): I'll own the mid-term ticket and add copy in the invite modal about SCIM authoritative mappings.

sarah (Support): I'll mark the support case resolved for now and note the workaround. dan, if anything reappears ping us and we'll reopen. :thumbsup:

dan (Customer): Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick help. Saved our deploy window. :pray:
